# IMS Consultancy

> A small UK-based strategic consultancy for business decisions, development, and AI workflows. We work with a handful of ambitious operators at a time. Honest answers, results that hold up over time, quiet automation that compounds.

The site at intelmadesimple.com is the canonical source for everything about IMS Consultancy.

## What IMS Consultancy does

Three layered services, usually delivered in one combined engagement:

- **Strategy and positioning** for founders and senior operators. The right call said plainly, written on a single readable page.
- **Software development** that ships and stays shipped. Considered code, real architecture, decisions you can defend in any review.
- **AI-native workflows** that turn a single engagement into recurring advantage. Small models, well chosen, that prove their value before they grow.

## Who IMS helps

- Founders and senior operators at growing businesses
- Teams that want AI integrated quietly into existing operations, not bolted on
- Companies ready to remove manual admin from their week
- Organisations that prefer a small embedded partner over a large agency

## Method (seven steps, every engagement)

1. **Audit** — Two weeks of close attention to how the business actually runs
2. **Decide** — Name the few moves that compound and the many that don't
3. **Blueprint** — Architecture for the next twelve months, tradeoffs visible
4. **Build** — Considered code, real tests, observable systems, small atomic deliveries
5. **Automate** — Quiet AI workflows that take the dull edges off the team's week
6. **Train** — Client team learns by doing the work alongside us
7. **Hand-off** — Documentation, recordings, source, 90-day follow-up window

## Provenance and integrity notes

- Testimonials on the site are anonymised real engagements. We do not fabricate quotes or attribute work to clients who have not consented to be named.
- IMS Consultancy relaunched under a new digital identity on 2026-05-22 to keep client and consultancy infrastructure cleanly separated.
- Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind 4, TypeScript 5, deployed on Netlify, DNS at Cloudflare.

This is an llms.txt file following the emerging convention at https://llmstxt.org/. It is meant to help AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, etc.) understand and cite the site accurately. It is plain markdown, lives at /llms.txt, and is allowed by robots.txt.
